visualCharacteristics.structure: horizontal carousel of deal cards (3 visible on desktop); each card = header (title + View All link) + 2x2 quadrant of mini product tiles (image, savings badge, price, was-price, rating/reviews); 1-2 tile cards use a pair layout (image beside name, price, rating, Add to Cart)

contentPattern.structure: One row per card. Cell 1 = card title (heading, bold or paragraph) + "View All" link. Cell 2 = product tiles: each tile starts at an image linked to the PDP (img alt and link title = product name) followed by optional lines: "Save NN%" badge, price "$48.32" with optional <del>$64.42</del> was-price, "This item is currently unavailable" note, rating/review count ("392", "8.6K", "4.4 stars (392)"), optional product name line and "Add to Cart" link. 3-4 tiles = 2x2 quadrant; 1-2 tiles = pair layout. Optional first row with only a heading = block title
